name: build-freshness
description: 配信中の web ビルド版数を検知し、古い PWA キャッシュを破棄して最新ビルドへ切り替える。
cardTemplate: Summarise the build-freshness domain: build identity emission, no-store metadata delivery, stale-cache detection, and bounded PWA reload recovery.
rationale: The feature spec defines one lifecycle boundary from build identity generation through runtime freshness detection and cache recovery.
